title: Vortex Sour Mad Blue 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salt Mad Blue combines the juicy sweetness of Blueberry, the tangy sharpness of Raspberry, and the deep richness of Blackcurrant. This layered fruit medley delivers a bold and vibrant vape, ideal for vapers who love complex and flavourful blends. Crafted with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Mad Blue offers smooth vapour production and intense flavour, making it perfect for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) devices such as pod kits and starter systems. The nicotine salt formulation provides smooth throat hits and fast nicotine satisfaction, ensuring a convenient and enjoyable vaping experience. Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salts come in a 10ml format, offering a more sustainable and cost-effective alternative to disposable vape bars. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Mad Blue is a flavour-packed option for fruit fans.
